name: Steam (standalone)
author: Hydra
description: Install and launch the Steam games you own without the Steam client, using the built-in Go depot downloader (Steam login via DepotDownloader). Games that need the Steam client at runtime still get the real client, started hidden.

requires.hint: get the linux-x64 binary from github.com/SteamRE/DepotDownloader/releases and put it on your PATH as depotdownloader (needs dotnet runtime 8+)
install the .NET runtime from https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download or your distribution (dotnet-runtime-8.0 or newer)
only needed for games that refuse to run outside the Steam client; install it from your distribution or store.steampowered.com
